SELECT singer.Name, singer.Country
FROM singer
JOIN singer_in_concert ON singer.Singer_ID = singer_in_concert.Singer_ID
WHERE singer_in_concert.concert_ID = (SELECT concert.concert_ID FROM concert WHERE concert.concert_Name LIKE 'Hey' AND concert.Year = concert.Year)

SELECT StuID, weight
FROM Has_Pet
WHERE PetID IN (
    SELECT PetID
    FROM Pets
    WHERE PetType = 'dog' OR PetType = 'cat'
    AND pet_age > 1
)
SELECT StuID FROM Has_Pet INNER JOIN Student ON Has_Pet.StuID = Student.StuID WHERE Student.LName = 'Smith';

SELECT StuID, PetID, PetType, pet_age, weight
FROM Has_Pet
JOIN Pets ON Has_Pet.PetID = Pets.PetID
JOIN Student ON Has_Pet.StuID = Student.StuID
WHERE Student.Major = 1
GROUP BY StuID, PetID, PetType, pet_age, weight
HAVING PetID IS NOT NULL;
SELECT Model FROM car_names WHERE Horsepower = (SELECT MIN(Horsepower) FROM cars_data) GROUP BY Model;

SELECT FullName FROM car_makers

SELECT FullName FROM countries
WHERE CountryName IN (
    SELECT CountryName FROM countries
    JOIN model_list ON model_list.Maker = countries.CountryName

)
